whoAmI.main_statement: I am a full-stack software engineer dedicated to building high-performance digital products where robust logic meets seamless user experience.
whoAmI.paragraph_1: My work exists at the intersection of complex system architecture and intuitive design. I don't just write code; I architect end-to-end solutions that prioritize scalability, security, and maintainability.
whoAmI.paragraph_2: With deep roots in the JavaScript ecosystem—from optimized React interfaces to resilient Node.js/Next.js backends—I focus on creating fluid applications that feel natural and perform at scale. Every line of server logic and every millisecond of latency matters.

hero.title: Smokins Loyalty App
hero.description: Digital transformation of a retail chain's loyalty program

intro.mainText: Smokins is a retail chain that replaced paper stamp cards with a fully digital loyalty ecosystem.
intro.subText: The interface was built utility-first: speed and high contrast were the priority, letting staff close a transaction at the register in as few taps as possible.
intro.techText: The core technical requirement was a scalable, cross-platform solution that runs the same business logic regardless of the device's operating system.

appUx.title: App Interface
appUx.description: Designed for fast navigation and maximum contrast under the harsh lighting conditions typical of point-of-sale environments.
appUx.bottomText: Scanning and points redemption were reduced to a two-step flow, cutting checkout time by 40%. A flattened screen hierarchy removes unnecessary transitions, while large touch targets keep mis-taps to a minimum during peak hours.

sellerPanel.title: Seller Panel
sellerPanel.description: A tool for store staff to verify customers and award loyalty points.
sellerPanel.bottomText: The panel runs identically across tablets, phones, and older in-store devices, with no drop in performance or responsiveness. The authorization and validation layer was designed to minimize the risk of manual point-awarding abuse.

hero.title: Blitzform 3D
hero.description: Digital showcase and mobile parts factory app for a 3D printing startup

intro.mainText: Blitzform builds containerized, mobile industrial 3D printing factories designed to operate in demanding field conditions.
intro.subText: The brief called for a fast, no-frills site with clean UX that reflects the brand's engineering-first identity, while previewing the upcoming app built around a virtual parts database.
intro.techText: The frontend was built in plain JSX for maximum UI flexibility, while the warehouse and virtual factory logic runs on strongly-typed TypeScript to reduce errors as the parts database scales.

appUx.title: Industrial Interface
appUx.description: Built for clarity, blending the raw aesthetic of industrial systems with a modern UI layer.
appUx.bottomText: A dark theme and precise typography establish a technical, professional identity while keeping data-dense screens fully legible. The visual hierarchy guides users from brand messaging down to specific product parameters without losing context along the way.

mobileUx.title: Mobile-First Optimization
mobileUx.description: Fully responsive and fast-loading, built for users who open the site directly from the field.
mobileUx.bottomText: Page layout and asset sizes were optimized for the weaker network conditions typical of industrial and remote job sites. Critical content loads first, so the interface becomes usable before images and animations finish loading in full.

hero.title: Side Quests
hero.description: A collection of logo design, marketing graphics, 3D renders, and custom websites

intro.mainText: Side Quests is where the creative work lives — original logos, marketing graphics, 3D rendering, and websites.
intro.subText: Alongside full-scale app development, this covers client work in logo design, marketing creative, and website builds for both individuals and businesses.
intro.techText: Design work runs through Figma, Blender, and the Adobe suite (Illustrator/Photoshop), with sites shipped on WordPress or in plain HTML/JS depending on the project's needs.

corporateIdentity.title: Logo Design & Branding
corporateIdentity.description: Original logos, marks, and brand guidelines built from the ground up, including typography and color usage rules.
corporateIdentity.bottomText: Every logo starts with research and concept sketches, moves through vector work in Figma and Illustrator, and ends with a full brand guideline covering color variants and usage rules. That process keeps the mark consistent no matter where it ends up being used.

projects3d.title: Marketing & 3D Modeling
projects3d.description: 3D objects, product visualizations, and marketing graphics built for digital and print channels.
projects3d.bottomText: Models and scenes are built in Blender and rendered at resolutions suitable for both large-format print and social media, then finished in Photoshop for lighting, contrast, and consistency with the client's visual identity.

websites.title: Websites & WordPress
websites.description: Fast, fully responsive websites and landing pages built on WordPress or in plain HTML/JS.
websites.bottomText: Every site is optimized for load speed, basic SEO, and consistent rendering across mobile and desktop. Code and CMS structure are chosen so clients can update content themselves without touching the technical layer.
